description: Create a text, voice, forum, stage, announcement, or category channel, optionally inside a category, and optionally private or read-only from the start. private_to, read_only and posting_roles compile to permission overwrites and are applied in the same call, so a private channel is one request rather than a create followed by set_channel_permissions. Use set_channel_permissions for anything finer. Supports dry_run.

category.description: Category name or ID to place the channel under.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

posting_roles.description: Role names that may still post when read_only is set. Has no effect on its own.

private_to.description: Role names that can see the channel. Everyone else is denied View Channel, and Connect too on voice, stage and category. Do not list @everyone.

read_only.description: Deny sending to everyone, for rules and announcement channels.

name: create_channel
title: Create channel
